evidence.label: Pipeline fee
evidence.value: 0.25% of each swap's input, charged by the router on every hop and paid to Pipeline's treasury.
evidence.source: Pipeline docs/INTEGRATOR-GUIDE.md; constant text kept by Aviary

evidence.label: Router protections on swaps
evidence.value: The router moves your input into the strategy's vault, refuses the swap if you would receive less than your minimum, and never takes more than the amount you signed. You do not sign the call to the strategy, so it can pay you but cannot take from your accounts.

evidence.label: Custom actions
evidence.value: Any strategy instruction other than a swap is signed directly on the strategy; the router's protections and fee do not apply to it.

evidence.label: Bypass
evidence.value: A strategy may allow trades that skip the router; those pay no Pipeline fee and leave no swap event.

evidence.label: Vetting
evidence.value: Pipeline does not vet strategies; anyone can register one.

evidence.label: Router control on devnet
evidence.value: The router is upgradeable. Its upgrade authority 2yJJsmhvs2SBsKVtiKCG4wBJNoTH67aRNMhSwkupvUHZ is also its admin, who can pause swaps, market creation and registration.
evidence.source: Router ProgramData 3dpKiLED... and Config BmdeX3kW... read 2026-11-09 at slot 520324283

summary.text: This strategy appears to manage its token inventory itself: in the sampled market, custom actions burned tokens, paid tips to callers and sent fees to the launch creator.
Since its upgrade on 2026-11-08, 6 of its 8 markets, the sampled one included, cannot be traded through Pipeline.
The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace the code at any time, and there is no verified source.

claims.text: Its binary names its source pool4, and instructions named rebalance_wall, settle_retired and sweep_fees appear to run a buy wall, retire surplus tokens and pay out fees.
In the sampled market, settle_retired took 6,803,005.463489 tokens from the vault, paid the caller 0.22% and burned the rest.
sweep_fees paid 44,845.206080 tokens and 0.00025 SOL from the market's vaults to accounts of B1dQ...jiZE, without that key signing.
rebalance_wall paid its caller tips of 0.000307025 and 0.000030635 SOL from the market's SOL vault.
All 8 markets were created when launches on strategy ETrm...5zAb graduated, and none of them supports exact-out trades.
The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace the program's code at any time; it released 3 versions on 2026-11-08.
Since the last upgrade, 6 of the 8 markets fail every quote and swap; the sampled one holds 4.889389322 SOL that cannot be traded through Pipeline now.
The same key is the router's upgrade authority and admin, who can pause swaps.
The sampled token has no mint or freeze authority and no transfer fee.
On 2026-11-09, on the newest market, a tiny buy of 0.00001 SOL quoted back as a sale returned 98.64% of the input.
It refused exact-out quotes, and refused a swap call that skipped the router.
rebalance_wall, settle_retired and sweep_fees are called directly on the strategy, outside the router's protections and fee.
Trades through Pipeline get the router's minimum-output check and pay its 0.25% fee.
Its author has published no description: the metadata link returns an error.

unknowns.text: With no public or verified source, its fee rates, inventory rules and buy-wall rule are unknown.
Whether the 6 unreadable markets, and the funds in them, will become tradable again.
Who may call its custom actions; the callers seen so far were not the fee recipient.
Whether a sale works later or at larger sizes: the full exit test has not run.
